text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On this day, Daiichi Ruby was doing
independent training with K.S.Miracle.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: That's incredible! Even though we increased the weight from last time, you managed the same number of reps.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
The results are as expected.
Thank you for your assistance.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about it.
It's what roommates are for, after all.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
So, what should we do next?
Head back to the track and run again?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...No. I have finished today's routine,
so I am just cooling down.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
We will be doing uphill slope dashes next,
so please record my times.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: You just pushed yourself hard on the bench press, so I really think you should take a break...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"With my current ability, I cannot display the family's prestige to the world.
I must strive even harder."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
That's how it seemed, but... what's wrong?
Are you feeling sick or something?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
These are my trainer's instructions.
Over-training increases the risk of injury,
which ultimately leads to disadvantageous results.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No. I just thought to myself how deeply you trust them.
If that's the case, I'm relieved.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
As you can see, it has yielded results.
Trainer-san's instructions are well worth following.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: How should I put it... it's just like Ruby.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I do not believe I am doing anything special.
I am merely doing what is expected.
